candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, rustfmt, clippy, opening-book release tests, release-workflow contract tests, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly package generation, browser tests, package metadata validation, and generated JavaScript contracts passed. Version 0.4.3 improves bounded CSA supervision, eight-thread PGO evidence, and fail-closed qualification for disabled search experiments without adopting a new default evaluator or making a general playing-strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.3. PGO throughput evidence remains a separate fixed-condition performance result, not a playing-strength claim.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
New search and Lazy SMP policies without an independent H1 remain disabled-by-default experiments.
The qualified PGO throughput results apply only to the recorded Apple M4 four-thread and eight-thread configurations; ordinary release builds do not embed those profiles.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
